_comment: Tier-2 for sparta (all physics): every generator the catalog advertises is generated, validated, data-staged and RUN on the installed binary — 12 variants across 10 physics rows, all rc=0. Also gates payload hygiene: get_knowledge() must contain no absolute host path (the old 'installed_build' block hard-coded four) and every pitfall must carry a Signal: clause. The binary part skips cleanly when SPARTA is absent; the hygiene part always runs. KEY DRIFT FIXED 2026-08-06: this fixture was keyed pitfall_index 9, which on rarefied_flow is the universal [Setup] claim that 'global nrho ... fnum ...' must precede create_particles — a claim it never touches. So that claim read as covered while the evidence pointed at a catalog smoke test, the same defect found in three of FEBio's six pre-existing fixtures. The index is now SYNTHETIC (past the end of every pitfall list) and 'covers' is explicitly empty: this fixture is a catalog gate, not evidence for a pitfall. The nrho-ordering claim now has its own fixture, global_nrho_before_create_particles. MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): this fixture is a GATE — both its expectations assert the ABSENCE of a defect — so the control is the mirror of the usual one: instead of removing a pathology, T2_MUTATE=1 INJECTS the two defects the gate exists to catch and the gate must fire. It appends one absolute host path, '/home/someuser/sparta/src/spa_serial', to the _general blob the leak scan reads, and masks the 'Signal:' marker on the first pitfall the scan sees. The injection is local to the two scanned strings: nothing on disk and nothing served by get_knowledge() is modified. absolute_host_paths_in_knowledge goes [] -> [('_general', '/home/someuser')] and pitfalls_without_signal goes [] -> [('rarefied_flow', 0)]. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES (rc=0, with generators_executed=12 and generators_failed=[]); with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS (rc=1) and these expect_in_output strings go False and disappear: knowledge_has_no_host_paths=True, all_pitfalls_carry_a_signal=True. WHAT THE CONTROL COULD NOT REACH: the fixture's headline claim, that every advertised generator runs, is in no expect_in_output string at all — it rides entirely on the forbid string FAIL:. Since SKIP: is not forbidden here, on a host with no SPARTA binary this fixture PASSES on the two hygiene lines without generating or running a single deck. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/sparta/generators_execute_on_installed_build && python source.py (passes, rc=0), then T2_MUTATE=1 python source.py (fails, rc=1). Needs a SPARTA binary: the fixtures find spa_serial/spa_mpi on PATH or at ~/Schreibtisch/sparta/src/spa_serial, else set SPARTA_BINARY; with none present they exit 0 on a SKIP: line. Here specifically the generator half skips on that line while the payload-hygiene half the mutation touches runs either way.
